entries.title: 2 Chronicles 27:2
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: He did - He did according to all that his father Uzziah did; except in his miscarriages. We must not imitate those we have the greatest esteem for, any farther than we do well; but their failings must be warnings to us, to walk more circumspectly.

entries.title: 2 Chronicles 27:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Built - Repaired it: for it was built before, chap. 11:5.
